title: POV: payday was Friday and your balance still looks like this
description:
nobody teaches you how to check a paycheck. you see the number and hope it's right.

doubles, staying late, night shifts, overtime, deductions... by the time you add it all up by hand it's 1am.

we built ShiftPayday for exactly this. you log your shifts and it estimates your take-home with overtime, night premium and deductions, so you can check it against your stub before the money lands.

the calculator is free, no account needed. it's an estimate from the rates you enter, not tax advice.

#shiftwork #nightshift #payday #overtime #paycheck
